nodes.label: Animate Text Node Helper Scripts
nodes.rationale: Provides deterministic Node.js 20+ CLI shortcuts (list-specs, get-spec, get-effect, find-spec) while keeping Markdown and JSON usable without Node.

nodes.label: Hidden Bundled Specs (4 Website-Hidden Effects)
nodes.rationale: Bundled portable specs (depth-parallax-words, shared-axis-x, stagger-from-center, stagger-from-edges) remain usable for translation despite having showcase set to null.

nodes.label: Stack Mapping (WAAPI, Motion, GSAP, CSS-only)
nodes.rationale: Prevents unit/easing/keyframe mismatches such as ms vs seconds in Motion/GSAP or mixing per-keyframe segment durations with top-level duration in gsap.to.

nodes.label: Exact Effect Recipe Schema
nodes.rationale: Intentionally excludes non-animation presentation styling (font size, weight, color, padding, card chrome) while capturing exact runtime and renderer data.

nodes.label: showcase.library_adapters and library_selection Contract
nodes.rationale: Enforces binding adapter selection (waapi, motion, gsap) with explicit imports, time units, easing conversions, and cancellation rules.

nodes.label: showcase.renderer Contract
nodes.rationale: Encodes initial_state, canonical_loop_pseudocode, and keyframe_recipe for renderers (generic-stagger, shared-slide-opacity-stage, kinetic-center-build, kinetic-top-build) where prose is ambiguous.

nodes.label: Animate Text Skill
nodes.rationale: Separates portable motion contracts from exact generated recipes so agents can either translate motion intent across stacks or reproduce site animations 1:1.

nodes.label: Exact Effect Recipe (assets/effects/<id>.json)
nodes.rationale: Bundles resolved renderer, playback, timing, runtime, stage, rendering contract, and library adapters into a single authoritative artifact for 1:1 reproduction.

nodes.label: Portable Motion Contract (assets/specs/<id>.json)
nodes.rationale: Keeps sample copy out of motion specs so animations can be ported cleanly to WAAPI, Motion, GSAP, CSS, Lottie, or Rive.

nodes.label: ProPresenter Lyric Animator
nodes.rationale: Standalone Electron desktop app for ProPresenter v7/v20.x delivering After Effects-style In/Out lyric animations, 1:1 Theme/Slide fidelity, and NDI-free media playback.

nodes.label: ProPresenter Network API Sync (Port 50001)
nodes.rationale: Connects to ProPresenter Network API (default port 50001) and optional Folder Share ProPresenter network path when running on a separate machine.

nodes.label: Effect Family Selection Guide
nodes.rationale: Routes unnamed effect requests by motion granularity (per-character, per-word, per-line, whole-phrase) and layout awareness.

nodes.label: Application Launch Entrypoint (Jalankan_Lyric_Animator.bat / npm run app)
nodes.norm_label: application launch entrypoint (jalankan_lyric_animator.bat / npm run app)

nodes.label: Layout-Aware Kinetic Build Handling
nodes.rationale: Keeps build coordinates as raw renderer pixels in buildKineticFrame without scaling by y_travel_multiplier so multi-word push/reflow choreography is not flattened into generic stagger.

nodes.label: Showcase Swap Semantics (exit-before-enter)
nodes.rationale: Generic stagger loops enter the first phrase once and then cycle exit -> micro_delay_ms -> replace -> enter -> gap, ignoring swap.overlap_ms to match generated site behavior.

nodes.label: Text Ownership Policy
nodes.rationale: Preserves existing application copy by default and restricts showcase.content/assets/samples.json to demo or fallback use so parity work does not overwrite product text.

nodes.label: showcase.stage Host Requirements
nodes.rationale: Defines only animation host requirements (container, title, unit, kinetic_container, kinetic_word) so consuming apps retain their own typography, color, and layout.

nodes.label: Animation Translation and Parity Rules
nodes.rationale: Requires preserving target granularity, requested target library without substitution, layout-aware logic, and full showcase playback loops rather than first-enter-only reveals.
